verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local model runner, so on-device speech transcription is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions audio input, speech-to-text models, or real-time dictation. The documented capabilities cover text/chat models, coding-agent integrations, image generation on macOS, and a REST API, none of which is speech transcription.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model
